inference_policy.notes: Each axis is classified independently. Text prompts describe generic musical concepts only and never contain track-specific metadata.

family.label: Hip-Hop / Rap
family.prompt: Hip-hop and rap music centered on rhythmic vocal delivery, beat-driven production, drums, bass, sampling or programmed percussion.

family.label: Pop
family.prompt: Pop music with accessible songwriting, memorable hooks, clear verse-chorus organization and polished mainstream production.

family.label: Electronic / EDM
family.prompt: Electronic dance music driven by synthesized sounds, programmed drums, electronic bass, club-oriented production and electronic arrangement techniques.

family.label: R&B / Soul / Funk
family.prompt: R&B, soul and funk music with groove-focused rhythm, expressive vocals, syncopation, soulful harmony and bass-led pocket.

family.label: Vietnamese / Asian
family.prompt: Vietnamese or closely related Asian popular and traditional music whose melody, phrasing, instrumentation or cultural style is recognizably rooted in Vietnam or East and Southeast Asia.

family.label: Rock
family.prompt: Rock music built around guitars, bass and drums, from alternative and indie rock to heavier guitar-driven forms.

family.label: Country / Acoustic
family.prompt: Country, folk or acoustic-oriented music led by organic instruments such as acoustic guitar, strings, piano or roots instrumentation.

family.label: Latin
family.prompt: Latin music shaped by Latin American rhythmic traditions, percussion patterns, dance grooves, guitar or regional melodic language.

family.label: Cinematic / Classical
family.prompt: Cinematic score or classical-oriented music led by orchestral, chamber, piano, string or soundtrack-style composition.

style.label: Cyber Trap
style.prompt: Cyber trap: dark futuristic trap with heavy 808 bass, hard programmed drums, synthetic textures, digital distortion, glitch details and an aggressive technological atmosphere.

style.label: Industrial Hip-Hop
style.prompt: Industrial hip-hop: abrasive rap production with distorted drums, metallic percussion, noise, mechanical textures, heavy low end and harsh industrial sound design.

style.label: Glitch Hop
style.prompt: Glitch hop: hip-hop-influenced electronic music with broken edits, stutters, digital glitches, syncopated bass, chopped rhythmic details and futuristic sound design.

style.label: Drift Phonk
style.prompt: Drift phonk: aggressive modern phonk with distorted cowbells, clipped bass, hard trap percussion, dark Memphis-derived vocal textures and high-energy driving momentum.

style.label: Electronic Drill
style.prompt: Electronic drill: drill rhythm and sliding low bass combined with synthetic, futuristic or heavily electronic production and dark aggressive sound design.

style.label: Grime
style.prompt: UK grime: British MC music around roughly 140 BPM with sparse angular electronic riddims, icy square-wave synths, syncopated drums and distinctly UK grime rhythmic language.

style.label: Trap
style.prompt: Trap music with rolling hi-hats, punchy programmed drums, deep 808 bass, sparse dark harmony and rap-oriented production.

style.label: Drill
style.prompt: Drill music with dark minor-key atmosphere, sliding bass, syncopated kick patterns, tense percussion and aggressive rap production.

style.label: Phonk
style.prompt: Phonk rooted in Memphis rap aesthetics, lo-fi or distorted texture, sampled rap vocals, cowbell motifs, dark bass and hypnotic beat loops.

style.label: Boom Bap
style.prompt: Boom bap hip-hop with hard kick and snare emphasis, sample-based production, head-nod groove and classic rap rhythm.

style.label: G-Funk
style.prompt: G-funk with laid-back West Coast hip-hop groove, deep bass, melodic synthesizer leads, funk-derived harmony and relaxed rhythmic pocket.

style.label: Alternative Hip-Hop
style.prompt: Alternative hip-hop that departs from mainstream rap conventions through unusual production, experimental textures, unconventional sampling or hybrid songwriting.

style.label: Dancehall Pop
style.prompt: Dancehall pop: melodic pop songwriting over a recognizably Caribbean dancehall groove, syncopated dembow-related rhythm, dancehall percussion and bright modern pop production.

style.label: Eurodance
style.prompt: Eurodance: energetic European dance-pop with four-on-the-floor club drums, bright synthesizers, strong melodic hooks, pumping bass and a late-1990s to 2000s dance feel.

style.label: Euro-House
style.prompt: Euro-house: European pop-house with steady four-on-the-floor rhythm, house piano or synth chords, club bass and accessible vocal hooks.

style.label: Afropop
style.prompt: Afropop: contemporary African pop with interlocking percussion, syncopated groove, melodic vocals, warm rhythmic bass and modern polished production.

style.label: Synth-Pop
style.prompt: Synth-pop with melodic pop songwriting led by synthesizers, electronic drums, clean hooks and polished electronic production.

style.label: Synthwave
style.prompt: Synthwave inspired by 1980s electronic music, analog-style synthesizers, retro drum machines, arpeggios, cinematic neon atmosphere and nostalgic production.

style.label: House
style.prompt: House music with a steady four-on-the-floor kick, repetitive dance groove, electronic bass, hi-hats and club-focused arrangement.

style.label: Deep House
style.prompt: Deep house with warm bass, restrained four-on-the-floor rhythm, soulful or atmospheric chords and smooth late-night club production.

style.label: Techno
style.prompt: Techno with repetitive machine-driven rhythm, four-on-the-floor kick, synthetic percussion, hypnotic sequencing and minimal club-focused structure.

style.label: Trance
style.prompt: Trance with driving electronic dance rhythm, long builds, arpeggiated synthesizers, euphoric harmonic movement and expansive breakdowns.

style.label: Dubstep
style.prompt: Dubstep with heavy sub-bass, half-time or broken electronic drums, aggressive bass sound design, drops and strong dynamic contrast.

style.label: Drum and Bass
style.prompt: Drum and bass with fast breakbeat-driven percussion, deep sub-bass, high tempo and energetic electronic production.

style.label: Neo Soul
style.prompt: Neo soul with laid-back pocket, expressive soulful vocals, rich jazz-influenced harmony, organic R&B instrumentation and nuanced groove.

style.label: Contemporary R&B
style.prompt: Contemporary R&B with smooth modern vocal production, groove-centered drums, polished bass, emotional harmony and modern pop-influenced R&B arrangement.

style.label: Soul
style.prompt: Soul music with expressive vocals, gospel or blues-influenced harmony, organic rhythm section and emotionally direct melodic phrasing.

style.label: Vietnamese Bolero
style.prompt: Vietnamese bolero: slow sentimental Vietnamese popular music with gentle bolero-derived pulse, expressive lyrical melody, romantic vocal phrasing and often acoustic guitar or traditional-influenced ornamentation.

style.label: V-Pop
style.prompt: Contemporary Vietnamese pop with modern pop production, Vietnamese melodic and vocal phrasing, polished hooks and current mainstream arrangement.

style.label: Vietnamese Folk
style.prompt: Vietnamese folk music with traditional melodic contours, regional vocal phrasing, folk instruments or acoustic textures rooted in Vietnamese musical traditions.

style.label: Country
style.prompt: Country music with acoustic or electric guitar, roots rhythm section, narrative songwriting, country vocal phrasing and Americana-influenced harmony.

style.label: Folk
style.prompt: Folk music centered on acoustic instrumentation, direct songwriting, organic performance and traditional or singer-songwriter melodic language.

style.label: Alternative Rock
style.prompt: Alternative rock with guitar-led band instrumentation, energetic drums, non-mainstream rock textures and modern alternative songwriting.

style.label: Indie Rock
style.prompt: Indie rock with guitar, bass and drums, independent rock aesthetics, melodic songwriting and comparatively raw or distinctive production.

style.label: Shoegaze
style.prompt: Shoegaze with dense layers of distorted and reverberant guitars, hazy vocals, dreamlike texture and a wall-of-sound mix.

style.label: Cinematic Score
style.prompt: Cinematic score music with orchestral or hybrid soundtrack writing, dramatic development, atmospheric tension and scene-oriented composition.

tradition.label: Nhạc Vàng
tradition.prompt: Nhạc Vàng, the Vietnamese sentimental popular-song tradition associated with nostalgic melody, lyrical emotional delivery and pre-1975 or tradition-influenced Vietnamese popular music.

tradition.label: Nhạc Trữ Tình
tradition.prompt: Nhạc Trữ Tình, Vietnamese sentimental lyrical music centered on tender expressive melody, romantic themes and emotionally direct vocal phrasing.

tradition.label: Vietnamese Traditional
tradition.prompt: Traditional Vietnamese musical language with culturally specific melodic contours, ornamentation, instruments or regional vocal phrasing.

tradition.label: Contemporary / No Specific Tradition
tradition.prompt: Contemporary globally produced music without a strong identifiable regional traditional-music lineage.

form.label: Sentimental Ballad
form.prompt: A slow or moderate sentimental ballad focused on emotional melody, lyrical vocal delivery and gradual song-form development.

form.label: Pop Ballad
form.prompt: A modern pop ballad with clear verse-chorus songwriting, emotional vocal melody and polished pop production.

form.label: Rap Song
form.prompt: A rap-centered song form dominated by verses, hooks and rhythmic vocal delivery over a beat.

form.label: Club / Dance Track
form.prompt: A dance or club track structured around repeated grooves, builds, hooks and electronic energy rather than narrative ballad form.

form.label: Electronic Hybrid
form.prompt: A hybrid electronic song form combining vocal or rap sections with electronic production, contrast sections, breaks or drops.

form.label: Instrumental / Cinematic
form.prompt: An instrumental or cinematic form organized around musical development, atmosphere and sections rather than a conventional vocal verse-chorus song.

form.label: General Song Form
form.prompt: A general contemporary song form without a uniquely dominant ballad, rap, club or cinematic structural identity.
